$comment: The two Supabase projects, addressed by REF because the NAMES ARE BACKWARDS.
The project named 'courtsimplified-dev' is production. The project named
'courtsimplified' is dormant and paused. Until they are renamed, any tool
that resolves a project by name will pick the wrong one, so nothing in this
'currentName' records what each project is called TODAY. 'intendedName' is
what it will be called after the rename described in docs/lso-fixes-report.md.
When the rename is done, move each intendedName into currentName and set
'renameComplete' to true -- scripts/db/applyMigrations.ts prints a warning
while it is false, and that warning is the reminder.

notes: VERIFIED ACTIVE 2026-09-26 by supabase projects list. It was recorded as PAUSED
